t: Why he gave to the person he thought less of
a: يَا سَعْدُ، إِنِّي لأُعْطِي الرَّجُلَ وَغَيْرُهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْهُ، خَشْيَةَ أَنْ يَكُبَّهُ اللَّهُ فِي النَّارِ
p: Yā Saʿd, innī la-uʿṭi-r-rajula wa ghayruhu aḥabbu ilayya minh, khashyata an yakubbahu-Llāhu fi-n-nār
m: Saʿd, I give to a man while someone else is dearer to me than him, out of fear that Allah would throw him on his face into the Fire.
